scope: New fixed-state loss and gradient measurements on existing development artifacts; no optimizer steps or refits. Not confirmation, R1 or R3.

snapshot_rules.pure_gradients: Use best state for gradients at assessed predictor; do not assign it latest Adam moments.
snapshot_rules.optimizer_aware: Use latest model with its own optimizer, exact parameter order/groups and stored hyperparameters. State differs from assessed best if epochs differ.
snapshot_rules.unavailable_state: No best_optimizer or best_rng exists in saved schema. Do not invent them.
snapshot_rules.identical_best_latest: Deduplicate only if exact tensor identity is verified before any measurements; otherwise label separate snapshots.

data_access.membership: Reconstruct the frozen532fit rows and54selection rows using the verified driver and admission dates. Assessment55 is not used for gradient selection; calibration53 and evaluation608 arrays must never be deserialized.

maximum_new_computation_proposal.autograd_evaluations: At most two loss-component gradient evaluations per forward for each labeled state; preserve zero/unused gradient positions.

metrics_to_record: MSE_sigma_scaled and CRPS term separately, with exact training-only scales and actual lambda
gradient norms and dot/cosine by shared encoder and atomic head at the same state and batch
zero/unused/nonfinite gradients and numerical support; no epsilon presented as measured conflict
proposed full gradient, clipping coefficient and optimizer displacement using a detached copy of matched latest state only
g_MSE dot hypothetical displacement; label local first-order geometry, not finite-step or held-out improvement
atom locations, probabilities, transformed-support margin and output-law mean as aggregate diagnostics; no checkpoint payload publication

interpretation_before_results.sign_conflict: Negative cosine is local geometry only. If every supported measured state has nonnegative cosine, sign conflict was not observed in this scope; do not claim universal absence.
interpretation_before_results.SGD_geometry: gM dot (gM+lambda*gA) concerns an ordinary gradient direction. Do not transfer its sign to Adam without its coherent moments/preconditioner.
interpretation_before_results.Adam_geometry: For displacement d=theta_proposed-theta_current, gM dot d>0 predicts an infinitesimal first-order increase; it does not establish a finite-step or generalization loss.
interpretation_before_results.no_adaptive_tuning: Do not choose lambda, seed, epoch, subset or a new stop rule from assessment outcomes. This study selects no model and has no predictive superiority endpoint.
interpretation_before_results.novelty: Projection/gating already has prior art. A positive diagnosis motivates a separately reviewed adaptation, not R1 accreditation.

before_execution: Review exact code/schema, named-parameter alignment, training/selection membership and forbidden-array guard.
Bind method code, input hashes and fixed batches and record a real prior anchor for this measurement. It cannot preregister the already exposed pilots.
Verify safe checkpoint loading of the authenticated local payload without changing source states.
Use model.eval with autograd enabled and unchanged weights; no training loop, optimizer.step, checkpoint overwrite or forecast publication.
Define a separate output directory with completed/incomplete receipt and exact computation counters. Stop unsupported cases without silently changing the plan.

gradient_notation.g_A: gradient of normalized auxiliary loss WITHOUT lambda
gradient_notation.MSE_only_effective_auxiliary_gradient: zero; do not report an actual auxiliary conflict cosine
gradient_notation.counterfactual_auxiliary_on_MSE_only: If computed under this diagnostic, keep unweighted geometry as explicitly counterfactual, never as the recipe actual loss/gradient; no counterfactual optimizer step.
